summary: Tested 3 new features: 1) Duplicate quote 2) Edit quote 3) Templates. All features working correctly. Backend tests 100% pass. Frontend tests pass with one known issue: quotes with deleted clients cannot be edited/downloaded (expected behavior - backend validates client exists).
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/templates returns 6 predefined templates
Backend: Templates have correct quote types (standard, moduli, step, ibrido)
Backend: POST /api/quotes/{id}/duplicate creates new quote with new number and draft status
Backend: Duplicate preserves all quote content (services, steps, premise, etc.)
Backend: PUT /api/quotes/{id} updates quote subject and services
Backend: POST /api/templates/from-quote/{id} saves quote as template
Backend: PDF generation works for all quote types
Frontend: Templates page loads with 6 predefined templates
Frontend: Quotes list shows Edit (pencil) and Copy (duplicate) icons for each quote
Frontend: Duplicate button in quotes list creates new quote with toast 'Preventivo #N duplicato!'
Frontend: Duplicated quote has draft status (Bozza)
Frontend: Edit button navigates to /preventivi/:id/modifica
Frontend: Edit page shows 'Modifica Preventivo' title
Frontend: Edit page pre-fills client, subject, services from existing quote
Frontend: Save button shows 'Aggiorna Preventivo' in edit mode
Frontend: Quote update shows toast 'Preventivo aggiornato!'
Frontend: Quote detail page shows Modifica, Duplica, Salva come Template buttons
Frontend: Template selection available in step 1 of new quote wizard
Frontend: Loading template shows toast 'Template X caricato'
Frontend: Save as Template prompts for name and saves successfully
critical_code_review_comments: Edit flow fails gracefully when client_id references deleted client (returns 404) - this is correct behavior but could show better error message to user

test_credentials.note: Previous test clients (TEST_UI_Client_StepQuote) were deleted by cleanup - quotes referencing them will fail edit/PDF

context_for_next_testing_agent: 3 new features fully tested and working: 1) Duplicate quote via POST /api/quotes/{id}/duplicate - creates new quote with incremented number and draft status. 2) Edit quote via PUT /api/quotes/{id} - frontend uses /preventivi/:id/modifica route, reuses NewQuotePage component with isEditing flag. 3) Templates - 6 predefined templates seeded, can load template when creating new quote, can save quote as template from detail page. Note: Some test quotes (2-5) reference deleted test client and will fail edit/PDF operations - this is expected behavior as backend validates client exists.

duplicate_quote.ui_location: Quotes list (Copy icon) and Quote detail page (Duplica button)
duplicate_quote.behavior: Creates new quote with new ID, incremented quote_number, draft status, preserves all content

edit_quote.ui_location: Quotes list (Edit icon) and Quote detail page (Modifica button)
edit_quote.behavior: Loads existing quote data, allows modification, saves changes

templates.ui_location: Templates page (/template), New quote wizard step 1, Quote detail page (Salva come Template)
